name: MacOS Shell
description: macOS Tahoe look for GNOME Shell in one extension: menu bar, animated dock, desktop widgets, notifications, lock screen and Spotlight, plus macOS volume and brightness pop-ups, title bar buttons, the genie minimize animation, shake-to-find for the cursor, Launchpad and macOS-style system dialogs. Every module can be switched on or off in the preferences. Languages: English, Russian.
